components.name: LoginSubmitButton
components.usage: Production login action uses SystemTheme button tokens and disabled/loading states. Login page shares one SystemThemeScope with its form and policy action; legacy background/layout remain. Validation and auth errors belong to the page.

components.name: PrivacyPolicyView
components.usage: Static bundled long-form policy, shared SystemPage and SystemSectionCard; no loading/empty/error state because no runtime data fetch.

components.name: YellowRibbonCountBadge
components.usage: Shared capsule for directory cards and below avatars; preview includes 0, 12, 128 and both avatar contexts.

components.name: StudentProfileOverview
components.usage: Name and section headings use shared primaryText; labels use secondaryText. Existing cases support catalog themes and Light/Dark through ProductPreview.

components.name: SystemPageHeader
components.usage: Shared page header for roster, daily attendance, daily performance and growing report: title, subtitle, primary action top-right and white filter fields on the theme headerGradient (background tokens only).

components.name: SystemPageInfoBar
components.usage: Line under the header: scope label (location, counts) on the left, view switch or statistics on the right.

components.name: ClassLocationFilterField
components.usage: Location dropdown bound to a ValueNotifier; styled by the surrounding input theme so it matches the roster filter.

components.name: SystemPillSegment
components.usage: Single-choice capsule segment for a few mutually exclusive options; 44px minimum hit area, selected tone from primary or a semantic status key. Used by the directory view switch and attendance status.

components.name: AttendanceRecordCard
components.usage: Daily roll-call card; all statuses visible as pills, leave reason expands only for leave. Height follows content (no fixed grid extent).

components.name: AttendanceSummaryBar
components.usage: Brand-tone header with date, location and live per-status counts; status is shown by label and count, not colour alone.

components.name: StudentGrowingReportCard
components.usage: Growing-report roster row sharing the directory card surface; navigation is the default onOpen and can be injected for previews.
